scenario: [LTIM.5.1] (LTIM.12.13, the id, is a tombstone): `>` is defined for `Date`, so `t.due > t.created` over two `Date` slots compiles.
rules_ds:
schema Task scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    due: Date mutable
    created: Date mutable

rule r:
    Task t where t.due > t.created
->
    log info "future due"
